RevoltDesigned For Custom CablesExtending the Revolt Series power supplies, Phanteks will offer a power supply without cables for users who want custom cables from CableMod. The new Revolt power supplies give you complete control to choose which power supply and which cables you need, saving needless cables in the process.
The Revolt power supplies from Phanteks have been developed with Seasonic to ensure the highest standards of performance and reliability. All models fully support and exceed the latest Intel ATX 3.0 specifications and come with either 80 Plus Platinum or Titanium certification. Wattage capacity ranges from 1000 watts all the way up to 1600 watts.
